parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of durable plastic, typically matching the seat in shape and size.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic purposes, and can be lifted or closed easily.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge at the back, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the toilet is the main structural component made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and water tank area.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, contains the water for flushing, and connects to the plumbing system for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor or wall, providing stability and support for the entire toilet structure.
